summary: Modal root wiring (owner direction 2026-11-07). Finding: the necessary-being route's NecessaryAt m.ontic w n is literally the Kripke box of TruthCore.Modal.Kripke over m.ontic.frame applied to the existence atom (necessaryAt_iff_boxExistsAt, Iff.rfl); the route needs no frame condition, so its necessity is in logic K, and no bridge identifies it with modal necessity. Certified a sense fork over 'necessary' (TruthCore.Causality.NecessarySenseFork): nine senses (box-existence K possibilist, actualist K, de dicto K, KT, S4, KTB, S5, tertia via 'cannot not-be' with diamond possibility, per se) with NecessaryIn by cases; per-branch theorems; joint fork theorem with OPEN coverage (STMT-NECESSARY-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE), exclusivity as a choice of one reading (STMT-NECESSARY-SENSE-UNIQUE) and side conditions (STMT-NECESSARY-INTENDED-SENSE-SUPPORTED); root route NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE-SENSE-FORK with the sense as parameter; nine strengthens registrations (S5->S4->T->actualist K->K->de dicto/tertia; S5->KTB->T; per se->tertia), using axiomT_valid, s5_implies_s4, s5_implies_ktb; controls with frame laws (axioms T, 4, B, Euclidean) and separations (T vs S4, actualist vs possibilist, de dicto vs de re, per se vs tertia) and one nonvacuity model. By-product (not modal): the two conjuncts of the met common-ground commitment STMT-CAUSAL-POWER-AND-ACTIVITY-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS registered as strengthens to STMT-CAUSERS-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS-AT and STMT-CAUSAL-POWER-REQUIRES-CONCRETENESS-AT, which establishes both and lowers NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE from 60 to 59 (ADOPTED-POTENCY 59 to 58). Rejected leads: (a) lowering the cheapest route (cost 30) with modal results: every leaf there is sourced/supported and proved from open premises, so only establishment lowers cost; modal results are premise-free certificates over specific frames while root vocabulary is parametric, so any modal derivation of a root leaf needs an open bridge (relocation, no cost drop). (b) Deriving STMT-GOD-IS-ETERNAL or STMT-GOD-IS-IMMUTABLE from modal necessity: worlds are complete histories; box-existence across histories gives neither everlastingness nor changelessness (#469), so no modal theorem discharges them. (c) Defining MerelyPossible modally to make STMT-MERELY-POSSIBLE-DOES-NOT-EXIST-AT analytic: it closes one leaf only by strengthening STMT-LACKING-ESSE-IS-MERELY-POSSIBLE to claim possibility of every non-actual candidate (false for impossibilia); not pursued. (d) Modal rival defence (#462 modal collapse, necessitism, #535 fixed history, #437 symmetry): no recorded alternative_to of any root-route premise is modal; recording a modal rival and refuting it with a premise-free model would defend nothing honestly (a refutation needs the rival's negation from established premises, and only eight floor items are established). No per-sense refutes relation applies: each failing branch fails by countermodel (non-entailment), not by refutation of a rival statement.
blocker: Route cost of the sense-fork route is 62 (the 59 of NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE plus the three OPEN fork premises: coverage, exclusivity, side conditions). The remaining NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE leaves are the 16 bare and 16 supported premises listed by frontier --routes; none is modal in content except the world-indexed bridges (LACKING-ESSE-IS-MERELY-POSSIBLE, MERELY-POSSIBLE-DOES-NOT-EXIST-AT, OCCURRING-THOUGHT-OCCURS-AT-WORLD, ESSE-CAUSES-EXIST-AT), which are parametric bridges a Kripke theorem cannot discharge without fixing their predicates.
